name: Hamiora Tamati
bio:
Hamiora's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for the roar of engines at the local speedway in Rotorua. Growing up tinkering with his dad's old Holden, he developed a knack for understanding how things worked. While his management skills aren't his forte, he's become a diligent and reliable pair of hands in the wind tunnel. He's keen to learn and develop his technical skills to contribute more to the team's aerodynamic development.

Though not a natural leader, Hamiora's loyalty to his team is unwavering. He takes immense pride in his work, ensuring the wind tunnel operates smoothly and efficiently. He understands the importance of meticulous data collection and accuracy, striving to improve the quality of testing and results. His quiet determination and eagerness to learn set him apart from other entry-level operators.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Hamiora is of average height with a sturdy build.

quirks: Always brings a thermos of strong black coffee.
Meticulously cleans his workstation at the end of each shift.
Has a habit of humming quietly while calibrating equipment.
